- **Linked Households (FL-911, FL-952, FL-979, FL-994, FL-998, FL-1012):** link with another Frameleaf household through Frameleaf Cloud, share a space with them, keep your own copy of what they share, and comment or like across households.
- **Family archive (FL-758, FL-842, FL-923, FL-933, FL-936, FL-955, FL-967):** split a flatbed scan into separate photos, keep the back of a print with its front and search its text, date a photo to a year or a decade, record family relationships, and repair or colourise old photos.
- **Places and maps (FL-925, FL-949, FL-964, FL-987, FL-999, FL-1019, FL-1027):** import your location history, fill in missing locations with undo, create named places, search the map by place, and see city, region and country names in your language.
- **More ways to bring photos in (FL-920, FL-944, FL-959, FL-972, FL-974, FL-995, FL-1742, FL-1749, FL-1751, FL-1752):** import from Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, WebDAV and Nextcloud. Noodle Gallery imports bring Spaces, people, favourites and pets, and iCloud hidden photos arrive as Locked.
- **Frameleaf Desktop makes video playback copies (FL-1758, FL-1759, FL-1761, FL-1762):** choose which approved computers convert videos so they play smoothly.
- **Everyday improvements (FL-880, FL-926, FL-976, FL-983, FL-1740, FL-1748, FL-1757):** Mother's Day and Father's Day memories, phone notifications through UnifiedPush and ntfy, a filter for photos in more than one album, Inter as the default font, a Back to top button, new-item counts for shared spaces, and one Add to album popup.
- **Privacy and security (FL-1743, FL-1763, FL-1631 to FL-1636):** album and space members no longer see each other's email address, Locked photos stay out of Memories, connected apps and API keys are better protected, and imported files can no longer reach outside their source folder.
- **Reliability (FL-57, FL-1741, FL-1755, FL-1763):** a drive that is briefly unavailable no longer makes photos look lost, an unmounted share can no longer send a library to the Trash, long jobs on large libraries keep running, Cloud Backup no longer reports success when nothing was stored, a partial refund no longer reopens a whole invoice, and Boards downloads no longer stall.
